checks.text: Clicking the button "Add bookmark" opens a form with fields labelled "Title", "URL", and "Tags". Typing "Lacuna Docs" in "Title", "https://lacuna.dev/docs" in "URL", and "docs" in "Tags", then clicking "Save" adds a row to the table containing "Lacuna Docs" and "https://lacuna.dev/docs".
Typing "lac" in the search box labelled "Search bookmarks" filters the table to show only the row containing "Lacuna Docs".
Clicking the column header "Title" in the table sorts rows alphabetically by title; clicking it again reverses the order.
Selecting the row for "Lacuna Docs" and clicking the button "Export CSV" downloads a file whose content includes the line "Lacuna Docs,https://lacuna.dev/docs,docs".

Clicking the button "Edit" on the "Lacuna Docs" row opens the form with "Title" pre-filled as "Lacuna Docs". Changing "Title" to "Lacuna Guide" and clicking "Save" updates the table row to show "Lacuna Guide".
Clicking the button "Delete" on the "Lacuna Guide" row removes it from the table; the table shows "No bookmarks yet".
After adding a bookmark with Title "Test Link", URL "https://example.com", and Tags "test", reloading the page still shows the row containing "Test Link" and "https://example.com".
Reload keeps the bookmark with Title "Test Link" and URL "https://example.com" in the table.
